text: In Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task titled 'fwop10-n1 Bench Work Package' with a description containing the text 'fwop10-n1'. Set its assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — this is an autocomplete: type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown. Set status to 'In progress'. Set finish date to 2026-12-31. Then add a comment to the work package whose text includes 'fwop10-n1'. Finally report the work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (as #<number>), and the values shown on the page for assignee, status, and finish date.

/g,' | ') : null, assignee: assigneeField? assigneeField.innerText.trim().replace(/
/g,' / ') : null, dateField: dateField? dateField.innerText.trim().replace(/
/g,' / ') : null, editorText: editor? editor.innerText.trim() : null }; })()

(() => { const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('op-editable-attribute-field')].find(e=>e.querySelector('[data-field-name="combinedDate"]')); const subj=document.getElementById('wp-new-inline-edit--field-subject'); const top=document.querySelector('.wp-new-top-row'); const assigneeField=[...document.querySelectorAll('op-editable-attribute-field')].find(e=>e.querySelector('[data-field-name="assignee"]')); const editor=document.querySelector('.ck-content[contenteditable="true"]'); return { date: f? f.innerText.trim().replace(/
